'''Klintok''' was a mutated [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoid]] who was among those that nested in the remains of the [[Bugtown|Farnel Research Facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />
